description: This is a Java enum class defining various book genres for the book project. It includes a list of genres, each with a string representation, and overrides the toString() method. It also uses custom annotations and external libraries like Jackson for JSON serialization.

classes.name: BookGenre
classes.description: Enum class representing various book genres, each associated with a string label and suitable for JSON serialization.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the genre, used for display and JSON serialization.
